propositions: Provider-native pre-client auth/session capabilities must be accepted and passed through LLMRuntime into the one per-run ProviderSession builder without altering RP-01 policy or forking the operation path
Rebar must construct, own, and close the official provider client; arbitrary constructed clients and second Agent/retry schedulers remain out of scope
Auth injection must fail before a provider model request if explicit auth is absent or conflicting, without fallback to anonymous, alternate-principal, or cross-provider alternatives

Credential material must not appear in config, request, snapshot, fingerprint, cache, CLI/MCP schemas, public output, logs, exceptions, or tracing boundaries and must unwrap only inside the selected provider builder

RP-01 authoritative offline oracles (S2/S3/S5) and candidate-tracing oracle must pass unchanged, with one Agent budget, complete-or-omit retry history, cache accounting, typed exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, usage, and failure contracts preserved
Live bounded Anthropic and Bedrock auth/cache canaries must complete successfully with provider-native authentication over the new LLMRuntime injection path without credential material recorded
